include: a final DESKAL-P19 exit matrix classifying every launch-completeness row as PROVEN, OUT_OF_SCOPE, or UNVERIFIED with exact evidence
regression tests proving SG-000087 through SG-000090 are CLOSED canonical and their public-launch invariants remain aligned
verification of canonical website identity, logo geometry, static export, responsive navigation, accessibility markers, canonical/social metadata, and canonical repository/release links
verification of zero-cost least-privilege GitHub Pages workflow, HTTPS publication, no custom domain, no deployment secret, and live Pages entrypoint
verification of canonical repository description, homepage, and topic allowlist
verification that analytics, telemetry, tracking, forms, authentication, payments, hosted APIs, databases, remote runtime assets, and client runtime behavior remain absent
final DESKAL-P19 program exit record with no new runtime or repository-administration authority

acceptance.claim: Every P19 exit-matrix row is classified PROVEN, OUT_OF_SCOPE, or UNVERIFIED with exact evidence, and no required or exposed launch row remains UNVERIFIED.
SG-000087 through SG-000090 are all CLOSED canonical and collectively prove website foundation, static hosting, canonical repository metadata/discoverability, and UX/accessibility/metadata hardening.

Regression tests prove the canonical logo hash, static export, zero client runtime, responsive navigation, accessibility markers, canonical/social metadata, canonical repository and Releases links, and forbidden hosted-service markers remain locked.

Live read-back proves the canonical GitHub Pages site is HTTPS reachable, Pages remains workflow-built with HTTPS enforced and no CNAME, and repository description/homepage/topics remain exactly canonical without mutating excluded settings.

Exact-head CI, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual review of excluded files, zero unresolved blocking review threads, normal merge, and post-merge CI complete before P19 is marked exited.

successor_requirements.post_p19: After P19 exits, any new feature, distribution change, custom domain, dynamic service, release mutation, compatibility migration, or runtime-authority change requires separately authorized successor work from live canonical truth.

done_when: DESKAL-P19 is exited canonically with a complete launch-completeness evidence matrix, no required UNVERIFIED row, no authority delta, exact-head qualification, live public-surface verification, normal merge, and green post-merge CI.
